title.zh: Coinbase 公布第三季度财报

current_state.zh: Coinbase 2026年Q3财报显示净利润7.19亿美元，调整后EBITDA为3.329亿美元、环比增长60%，USDC平均余额达220亿美元创纪录，预测市场年化收入超2亿美元，Base代币化股票累计交易量超10亿美元，加密交易市场份额升至10.7%。
current_state.en: Coinbase's Q3 2026 earnings show $719M net income, $332.9M adjusted EBITDA up 60% QoQ, record $22B average USDC balances, over $200M prediction-market annualized revenue, over $1B cumulative tokenized-equity volume on Base, and crypto trading market share at 10.7%.

updates.title_zh: Coinbase Swings to $719 Million Q3 Profit on Crypto Gains
updates.title_en: Coinbase Swings to $719 Million Q3 Profit on Crypto Gains
updates.what_changed_zh: Coinbase reported $719 million in Q3 net income ($2.51 per share) versus an expected loss, though roughly $715 million stemmed from gains on its crypto holdings, with adjusted net income at $78 million on $1.22 billion in revenue that was flat sequentially but down 35% year-over-year.
